{{Top|leg}}
The '''monarch-praefect''' was the title used by a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarch]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nazzri]]'s [[Nazzar government|government]] who was simultaneously a member of the council of [[praefect]]s, or the heads of the fourteen sects of Nazzri's state-enforced [[Ulizra]] religion. A [[Gender/Legends|male]] monarch-praefect was known as the '''king-praefect''' while a female monarch-praefect held the title of '''queen-praefect'''.<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
